text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин has suffered an injury, so
I've
brought her to the infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can hear just fine without you yelling in
my ear.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
This is nothing! It doesn't even hurt
anymore. I'm
good.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong so I can jump
right back
into trainin—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
I'll support you all the way!

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
I'll support you all the way!

text_block_list.text: Tch...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We don't have the time to be resting!
You of all
people should know that!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I keep getting held back like this, I'll
be stuck
as a weakling forever!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You need to rest or else you'll never recover.

text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP! Knock it off
with your
stupid reasoning!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
Would you rather I lie and only say what you
want to hear?

text_block_list.text:
Hell no! I'm not some dummy who wants
that
nonsense!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Damn it! This injury'd better heal at light

speed—or else!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm struck by the way she tries to get
back on her
feet despite her injury. I
reassure her that I'll
support her with all
of my being.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uh... okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear, but sheesh... You're
so
irritating.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, be quiet! You're making me lose
focu—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: OUCH!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Tch! I'm not Ticket, you know!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Then again, shouting does make it hurt
less, and
I feel more fired up... This is
really dumb, but...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
As a result, Нарита Таисин ends up
worsening her
injury в тренировке and
is forced to rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин shows off what she's got
and blasts
through her training for the
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин agrees to go to bed,
albeit rather
reluctantly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
